ارتضوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَوْا (irtaḍaw) /ir.ta.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضُوا (urtuḍū) /ur.tu.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اِرْتَضُوا (irtaḍū) /ir.ta.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
